description: A non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger, built on the native HTML Popover API — a borderless, shadow-defined surface with a pointer arrow, positioned with CSS anchor positioning across all twelve placements.

props.name: children
defaultOpen
props.description:
Whether the popover is open on first render. The component owns the flag
from then on (trigger toggles, `Popover.Close`, Escape, and light-dismiss
all mutate it internally).
Forbidden in controlled mode — use `open` instead.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description:
Called with the new open state after every transition. Optional in
uncontrolled mode; use it to observe (not drive) open/close.
Called with the requested open state whenever the popover wants to open
or close (trigger click, `Popover.Close`, Escape, outside dismiss).
Required in controlled mode — the popover will not move unless the parent
updates `open`.

props.name: open
props.description:
Forbidden in uncontrolled mode — use `defaultOpen` instead.
The current open state. Must be kept in sync by the parent via
`onOpenChange`.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the single child element instead of the default `<button>`,
merging the trigger's ARIA, composed event handlers, and ref onto it via
the {@link Slot } pattern.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Ref to the rendered element, composed with Root's internal trigger ref
(used for focus return on close). Defaults to `HTMLButtonElement`; with
`asChild`, set the generic to the child's element type
(e.g. `HTMLAnchorElement`).

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the single child element instead of the default `<div>`, projecting
the anchor onto an existing element via the {@link Slot } pattern.

props.name: children
props.description: Anchor content — the element(s) the popover should be positioned against.

props.name: asChild
props.description:
Render the single child element (e.g. a `<section>` or motion wrapper)
instead of the default `<div>`, merging the dialog props and internal ref
onto it via the {@link Slot } pattern.

props.name: children
props.description:
Panel content — typically {@link PopoverTitleProps`Popover.Title`},
body markup, and a {@link PopoverCloseProps`Popover.Close`}.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
Ref to the rendered element, composed with Root's internal content ref so
open/close and focus management keep working.

contractProps.name: size
contractProps.description: Panel size; `data-density` scales the padding within each size.

contractProps.name: placement
contractProps.description: Which side of the anchor the panel sits on, and how it aligns — sets the CSS `position-area` and points the arrow at the anchor. Requires the consumer to wire `anchor-name` (on the trigger or Popover.Anchor) + `position-anchor` (on Content).

props.name: asChild
props.description:

`<h2>` via the {@link Slot } pattern; the generated `id` is still applied
and registered.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the panel is open. Reflected: it changes as the user opens and dismisses it, so a server re-render or a history snapshot sees the live state. Set it (or the `open` property) to open or close the panel from script.

events.name: primitiv-popover-change
events.description: Bubbles, cancelable, fired before a user-driven change is applied — a trigger or close click, Escape, or a light dismiss — with the open state afterwards. Call `preventDefault()` to veto it.
